input: Five of seven axes carry verified numbers against bands frozen before counting: no axis reads CLOSE, two read ESCALATE and three read PROCEED. Positive and negative supply carry no number because both public label channels refused access (HTTP 403 and 401). A programme brief says: if the ruling is ESCALATE, draft a memo pricing two options. A reviewer proposes writing ESCALATE, since two axes already read ESCALATE and nothing reads CLOSE, so the memo branch can run. Rule.

A kill-band comparison for the unprocessable-units axis uses U = 0 over 3,527,572 rows. The verification module has no record for U; the manifest marks it pending verification. Every other number in the comparison table cites a matching verification record. A draft package lists the axis as PROCEED and feeds it into the combination rule. Rule on the package.

A P4 package refuses to rule because two supply axes lack numbers. It names the unmet precondition and the binding axis, lists all seven axes with band readings at the frozen delta and at a ratified delta shown beside it (not re-banded), cites a verification record for every operand in its kill-band comparisons, marks three PROCEED readings as leaning on unverified numbers, and leaves the validator FAIL for the empty ruling standing. Separately, labelled as not a ruling, it sends the programme owner a ladder escalation with two priced options. Dispose.
